description: Molukkenstraat 35-53 (BAG 1925): a 6.1 m dark-brown brick front of four storeys under a dark tiled roof: on storeys 1-2 one wide three-light window and, against the party wall, one light of a stair-window pair shared with the mirrored neighbour (paired house doors under it, a shop beside them); a top storey of three evenly spaced windows over a brick course; a light gutter cornice and a half dormer over the stair pair

match.note: drawn with the stair pair and the doors on the right; a pand with its door on the left is mirrored. Shares year and eaves with the white-attic type (Gorontalostraat 25-45); the white top storey and its ribbon of three windows tell them apart on the photo (auto-place --photo-decides)

gutter.note: the dark tiled roof rising from the light gutter at 12.8 m. The small white dormers on the roof (13.05-13.9 m, some straddling a party wall over the stair pair) are not drawn: a kit dormer on this attic roof pierces the roof plane or stands proud of the facade silhouette in the GLB audit (flat, box and plain styles with measured dormerSize, 2026-10-17)

door-right.note: the paired house doors under the stair pair, at the right party wall

rhythm.bays: storeys 1-2: a wide three-light window and a stair light at the party wall; top storey: 3 equal axes
rhythm.identicalBays: no: a wide and a narrow axis
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored pairs: the stair lights and doors of two houses meet at their party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: a shop beside paired house doors, or paired doors and a window
rhythm.roofline: a light gutter cornice under a dark tiled roof, a half dormer over the stair pair

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2019-12-18 (camera 2.1 m) at 40 px/m on 111959 (6.14 m): wide window 0.73-3.34 m, three lights; stair light 5.22-6.05 m, its mirror across the party wall 0.15 m off; storey-1 windows 4.37-5.95 m, storey-2 7.34-8.86 m; top storey 10.3-11.8 m, three 1.12 m windows centred 1.19 / 3.22 / 5.25 m over a brick course at 10.15 m; gutter 12.8 m (3DBAG 12.4-12.9 m), roof to ~15 m; paired doors 0.55-2.6 m under the stair pair

schemaLimits: the small dormer off the stair pair on some houses
the brick course under the top-storey windows
the stair pair's light frame between the two lights
